audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (a) 'Teemo's 500-range Blinding Dart out-ranges your Q detonation' — Blinding Dart is 680 and Inner Flame is 950, so Karma out-ranges him and the quoted 500 is wrong. (b) The blind is said to stop Gathering Fire stacks — Gathering Fire refunds Mantra off her damaging ABILITIES, not her autos, so a blind costs her almost nothing. (c) wants.foe[2] says to dodge the tether 'by breaking line of sight' — Focused Resolve breaks on distance.
audit.why: Together these tell a 950-range poke enchanter that she is out-ranged, that her core resource engine is shut off, and that the counterplay to her root is the wrong one. Every one of them is backwards.
audit.corrected: Range corrected to 950 vs 680 in whys[0], spikes[0], early and breakdown.cooldowns; Gathering Fire restated as ability-driven; Move Quick (14s) named as the thing that actually breaks the 675 tether.

kit Karma P text, Q range 950, W range 675

edits.before: Teemo out-ranges your Q detonation, and Blinding Dart shuts off the autos and on-hits that feed Gathering Fire — so you can't grind down his health or refund Mantra the way you do against an immobile mage. Last-hit at max Q range, accept a little E poison, and never throw Q into auto range where he blinds your follow-up and kites off. The play is to bait the blind first: once Dart is on its long cooldown, Q-W in and the tether threatens the root, but that's your only safe commit.
edits.after: You out-range Teemo — Inner Flame reaches 950, Blinding Dart only 680 — so the range war is yours if you last-hit from the edge and never step into Dart range. The blind is close to a red herring for your damage: Gathering Fire refunds Mantra off your abilities, not your autos, so keep casting through it. What actually beats you is Move Quick, which drifts him out of Focused Resolve's 675-unit tether before the root fires. Bait the Dart, then Q-W in during its flat 7s cooldown — that's your only safe commit.

notes: The '500-range Blinding Dart out-ranges your Q' line was flatly false in two ways — the number and the conclusion. Related and just as costly: the page blamed the blind for cutting Gathering Fire, but Karma's passive refunds Mantra off damaging abilities, so blind is close to irrelevant to her engine; the real problem is Move Quick breaking the 675 tether. Focused Resolve's reveal (a hard answer to Guerrilla Warfare) was missing and is now stated.
